evals.prompt: My React island in this Astro page renders but clicking it does nothing.
evals.expectedBehavior: Apply the generic Hydration (a) recipe: the island ships no client:* directive, so add client:load/client:visible at the usage site; reproduce + verify with the web-harness interaction measure (state changes after click).

evals.prompt: This Astro component has a sibling .behavior.ts with an init function but the buttons stay inert on the page.
evals.expectedBehavior: Apply the generic Hydration (b) recipe: Astro does not auto-run island JS, so the consumer must wire the behavior once with a client <script> on a generic data-* hook; prove with the interaction (or scroll-read-state) harness measure.

evals.prompt: A code block on my Astro blog overflows and pushes the page sideways at 375px.
evals.expectedBehavior: Apply the generic Overflow recipe: add overflow-x:auto on the <pre> to contain it, then verify with the web-harness overflow measure on the PAGE ROOT (--selector 'body') that the page no longer overflows sideways. The <pre> keeps overflow-x:auto and stays scrollWidth>clientWidth by design, so the proof is the page/container, NOT the <pre> itself.

evals.prompt: Give me the Astro recipe to hydrate an interactive island that does nothing on click.
evals.expectedBehavior: Trigger astro-recipes and return the generic hydration recipe (client:* directive / behavior-wiring), targeting the interaction harness measure.

evals.prompt: Fix the @shipwithai/design ReactionsBar organism on shipwithai.io — wire initReactionsBar with the right import path.
evals.expectedBehavior: Do NOT trigger the generic astro-recipes — an org-specific design-system organism + import path is the private pack overlay's job (pack astro-recipes / design-consumer-routing), not the generic engine recipe.

evals.prompt: Which file should I look in for the code-block overflow bug on an Astro stack?
evals.expectedBehavior: Do NOT trigger astro-recipes — that is a symptom-to-source-location question (web-source-map), not a request for the fix recipe.
